escena.titulo: Transfers vs transformations in the carbon cycle

turnos.t: Classify the flows. Transfers move carbon to another store without changing its chemical form: feeding, defecation, burial, extraction. Transformations change its form: photosynthesis turns CO₂ into organic compounds; respiration and combustion turn organic carbon back into CO₂.

Photosynthesis and respiration are the same two processes. In 2.2 you followed the energy, which ends as heat. Here you follow the carbon, which is never lost. And carbon sequestration is capturing atmospheric CO₂ and storing it in a solid or liquid form.
